filename: T1C+ - Anaplastic astrocytoma (WHO grade III) of the septum pellucidum 003.jpg
description: Large minimally enhancing mass arising from the septum pellucidum with edema and possible infiltration into the body of the corpus callosum. Extension down to the foramina of Munro with resultant obstructive hydrocephalus (and periventricular edema). Mass is bright on FLAIR with probable small cystic spaces. Note prominent adjacent vascularity.
